title: Lena Horne, movies and shows
summary: He recalls Horne with Sissle and Barnet, tours with Ethel Waters and Bojangles, and the Sophisticated Ladies show.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: They had a lot of movies, you know, with Lena Horne like Stormy Weather, Cabin In The Sky.
Right.
Did you have any
memories of those kinds of things?
I remember the movie. I went to see it. I was glad. I enjoyed it because I guess, I knew Lena Horne before she went into that.
And, I think Bill "Bojangles" Robinson was in there. Right?
Right.
Right. I remember him.
Fats Waller was in it too.
Right. Fats. Fats and myself used to have a lot of fun. He and Earl Hines and myself used to meet in Chicago a lot.

But, I enjoyed those movies. I remember doing a show in Cleveland, Ohio with Ethel Waters and Bill "Bojangles" Robinson at one of the RKO houses the, (inaudible) there. I was the band and they was, we was all three of us on the show together. That's when I, Steppin' Fetchit was another one. I did touring with during those years, although
they was a hit andI was going through the theater, but they asked for my band. So, I was with them for awhile.

I'm trying to think of who else that I knew. I remember Lena Horne before she, I remember Lena Horne when she was with Charlie Barnet when she was getting, she wasn't singing like she's singing today. But, she's doing good. But, she was a very good singer.
Oh, before that, she was with Noble Sissle[?]. Remember Noble Sissle[?]
Right.

Yeah, that's when I first met her. And then, after Noble Sissle[?], she was with Charlie Barnet. The next time I saw her after that, it was in California, Los Angeles. We was, we was out there for the theater. It was in Los Angeles for the week.
But, I'm gonna attempt to try to see her show. I understand it's a sellout all the time.
Right. It's very good reviews all the way around.
Mercer Ellington

(inaudible) caught me out on 48th Street between Fifth, right off of Fifth. And, that made my mind up to go catch that show. And I had this time. He said will you come on H? (we're holding up the traffic. Traffic was all stopped. And, I said I'll let you know. So, I got, I said give me, I had the time to write his phone number down.
Then, I got that number and I went in. I really enjoyed that show. But, I'm gonna try to catch another. All these years. Oh, I love things like that.
